facts.fact: 宴会天鹅脖颈被刀别直——餐桌即刑场
facts.anchor: Its neck is skewed with a long, thin blade

facts.fact: 母亲当席把女儿当饵，邀 Horewith 亲 Rue
facts.anchor: “You are enamored with my daughter, Lord Horewith.”
I feed my mother. I will always feed my mother.

facts.fact: 对勋爵承认与母同胃口
facts.anchor: He smells of the living, and similar to my mother, I long to consume him.

facts.fact: 人猪死声同——对勋爵留白
facts.anchor: I do not tell him how they sound the same when they die, pigs and men.

facts.fact: 红线拆解 Horewith 当众完成
facts.anchor: my mother pulls and pulls and pulls until he lies unraveled
I help her slip into her shallow grave.
She is rotting, but with sleep, she will rise anew.
The red seeps in, too dark and thick to be wine

facts.fact: 宴后找 Horewith 新鬼——Not yet
facts.anchor: I search the darkness for a new form
there was no escape for him the moment he crossed the threshold
